# Load libraries
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(randomForest)
library(ranger)
library(caret)
library(performance)
```

# Load data
```{r}
source("_config.r")

# Load plant model data
plant_data <- readRDS(PATH_MDL1_PLANT_DATA)
plant_richness <- readRDS(PATH_PLANT_RICHNESS)
```

# Data preparation
## Remove target column and plot ID
```{r}
# Remove year and ID columns after join
plant_data <- plant_data |>
  dplyr::select(-yearPl, -aID_STAO)

# Keep only climate variables for the 15 year aggregate
plant_data <- plant_data |>
  dplyr::select(-dplyr::matches("_(5|10|20|30)yr$"))

View(plant_data)
dim(plant_data) # 1449 x 120
```

# Species change modelling
## Fit per-plot linear regression and extract slopes
```{r}
# Require at least 3 observations per plot for a meaningful regression
lm_plant <- plant_richness |>
  group_by(aID_STAO) |>
  filter(n() >= 3) |>
  ungroup()

# Fit per-plot OLS regression and extract total percent change over observation period
plant_plot_slopes <- lm_plant |>
  group_by(aID_STAO) |>
  summarise(
    slope_year       = coef(lm(richness_plant ~ yearPl))[["yearPl"]],
    intercept        = coef(lm(richness_plant ~ yearPl))[["(Intercept)"]],
    n_obs            = n(),
    year_min         = min(yearPl, na.rm = TRUE),
    year_max         = max(yearPl, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_richness    = mean(richness_plant, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    fitted_start     = intercept + slope_year * year_min,
    fitted_end       = intercept + slope_year * year_max,
    total_change_pct = ifelse(mean_richness == 0, 0, ((fitted_end - fitted_start) / mean_richness) * 100)
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(total_change_pct)

# Print the number of NaN in total_change_pct
sum(is.na(plant_plot_slopes$total_change_pct))

# Save slopes for downstream modelling
write.csv(plant_plot_slopes, file = file.path(DIR_MDL1_OUT, "lm_plant_plot_slopes.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

### Plot per-plot regressions
```{r}
# Plot 5 specific plots selected plots with their fitted regression lines
set.seed(142)
IDs = c(503130, 491118, 503134, 503118)

obs_data <- lm_plant |>
  filter(aID_STAO %in% IDs)

ggplot(obs_data, aes(x = yearPl, y = richness_plant, color = factor(aID_STAO))) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 1) +
  geom_smooth(
    data = lm_plant, aes(x = yearPl, y = richness_plant),
    method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "darkred", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(2001, 2025)) +
  labs(
    title = "Plant Richness Over Time for Selected Plots",
    subtitle = "Solid lines = per-plot OLS fits, dashed = global OLS fit",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Plant Richness",
    color = "Plot"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# Save the plot of per-plot regressions
ggsave(filename = file.path(DIR_MDL1_PLOTS, "lm_plant_selected_plot_slopes.png"), width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

## Join the slopes with the environmental data for modelling
```{r}
# Join the slopes with the environmental data for modelling
plant_data <- readRDS(PATH_MDL1_PLANT_DATA)

# Keep only climate variables for the 15 year aggregate
plant_data <- plant_data |>
  dplyr::select(-dplyr::matches("_(5|10|20|30)yr$"))

# Join the slopes with the environmental data for modelling
plant_data_change <- plant_plot_slopes |>
  left_join(plant_data, by = "aID_STAO") |>
  dplyr::select(-aID_STAO, -richness_plant, -yearPl, -fitted_start, -fitted_end, -mean_richness, -year_min, -year_max, -n_obs, -intercept, -slope_year) # Remove ID, intercept and n_obs after join

dim(plant_data_change) # 1449 x 120
```

## Train test split
```{r}
set.seed(123)
train_idx <- caret::createDataPartition(plant_data_change$total_change_pct, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
plant_change_train <- plant_data_change[train_idx, ]
plant_change_test  <- plant_data_change[-train_idx, ]

dim(plant_change_train) # 1161 x 120
dim(plant_change_test)  # 288 x 120
```

## Fit random forest model to predict slopes (change rates)
```{r}
# Fit random forest model to predict slope of change in plant richness over time using environmental predictors
rf_plant_change <- ranger::ranger(
  total_change_pct ~ .,
  data = plant_change_train,
  num.trees = 500,
  mtry = floor(ncol(plant_change_train) / 3),
  min.node.size = 5,
  splitrule = "variance",
  importance = "permutation",
  num.threads = max(1, parallel::detectCores() - 1),
  seed = 123 # Set seed for reproducibility
)

# Save the model
saveRDS(rf_plant_change, file = file.path(DIR_MDL1_OUT, "rf_plant_change.rds"))
```

### Evaluate on test data
```{r}
# Predict on test data
rf_plant_change_test_pred <- predict(rf_plant_change, data = plant_change_test)

# Calculate performance metrics
r2_plant_change <- 1 - sum((rf_plant_change_test_pred$predictions - plant_change_test$total_change_pct)^2) / sum((plant_change_test$total_change_pct - mean(plant_change_test$total_change_pct))^2)
mse_plant_change <- mean((rf_plant_change_test_pred$predictions - plant_change_test$total_change_pct)^2)

r2_plant_change
# 0.059
mse_plant_change
# 2688.587
```
